rules.name: mandatory fields present, at least one item
rules.description: order_id, order_timestamp, cust_ref and a non-empty items array are required.

rules.name: order_id unique
rules.description: Webhook retries deliver the same order twice: first copy promoted, repeats quarantined.

rules.name: every line qty 1-50 and unit_price 0.01-5000
rules.description: One bad line quarantines the whole order so order totals stay consistent.

rules.name: SKU matches AAA-9999 with a known category prefix
rules.description: SKU prefix is how e-commerce lines map to the POS category taxonomy (conflict C3).

rules.name: order_total equals sum(qty x unit_price)
rules.description: Detects truncated item arrays or tampered totals.

rules.name: shipping_region and channel in reference domains
cust_ref exists in customer master
rules.description: Orphaned customer (deleted or never synced): order promoted with a flag.
